text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Happy New Yeeeear!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzt, wrong-!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"When hype meets 'Happy New Year,' you 
gotta hit 'em with 'Sei, lookin' forward 
to this year too,' right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Firm" is only for Hachimi? One more time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Happy New Year!? Sei!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, total buzzkill. Guess I gotta show you 
how it's done?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And so! Party people, come oooon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: 'Sup, 'sup☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, no! Happy New Year, let's have a 
great one~!
choice_data_list:
Your elegance is showing through, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Neigh-neigh hype vibes, totally lit! This 
is what partying is all about, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But man, this is really 
tough~! Feels like this is gonna be some 
brutal training.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin said she's gonna become a 
party animal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We're in the Classic year now, right? Time 
to get serious about running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gotta keep the hype up after all! I wanted 
to change things up starting with the 
mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be super cool just like Helios, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehh!? Cool!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Me!? I mean, I know I'm adorbs, but still!
choice_data_list: Helios can be pretty cool too, huh
Helios can be pretty cool too, you know

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right?! Trainer, you really get it!

Her sun-like brightness saves people. 
That's probably true for Mejiro Palmer, 
too. Even if she doesn't intend to do so 
herself, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? Kyaaah☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you and my besties stanning me a 
little too hard, Trainy-P!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So haaappy☆ Love ya both too~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And if Ruby gives me some love this year 
too, that'd be totally the best☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! What kind of strategy are we 
going with?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"First, we blow them away at the Aoi 
Stakes, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just run a ton of GⅠ races, and 
make 'em totally fall in love~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, like, Ruby, you're gunning for the 
Triple Tiara too, right?

Early in the new year, Daiichi Ruby 
announced her challenge for the Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always 
radiate the greatest brilliance"—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In accordance with the golden rule of my 
family, I shall now tread upon a path of 
splendor.

Following that bold declaration, the 
public's excitement instantly skyrocketed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A princess and a party animal make the 
ultimate balance!! I can only see us 
winning☆
(Woah woah woah...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Neh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I got so many invites on LANE!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: From who?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ines & Ryan, right? I got word from Jordan 
and City separately!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Roughly speaking... Do muscle training, 
take Insta pics, or browse high-end 
brands!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What would you do, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can't choose! Just make me look like a 
party animal!
choice_data_list:
Time to chill and get some aesthetic 
shots~

Wanna polish your style with some luxury 
brands?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So true☆ Alright, challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Are you... accepting my challenge?

Waiting in the gym were Mejiro Ryan and 
Ines Fujin... both classmates of Daitaku 
Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for accepting my challenge, 
Helios, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Let's start right now! Pair strength 
training showdown~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hold on! That's not fair, having 
Ryan on your team!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Objection overruled.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Besides, Helios-chan said it was fine~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios!? You know taking on Ryan in weight 
training is like fighting a bear 
bare-handed...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And yet, why...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! Besties for life are 
our greatest weapon!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have my bestie, I can get 
stronger. With muscle training... I'll 
even beat Ryan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...! Helios...!
choice_data_list: (...Is that just how their class is?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Have you made up your mind? Then to start 
off, piggyback squats!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just put your partner on your shoulders 
and do squats! Whoever completes the most 
reps wins!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! We'll win with bestie power!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Gnuu, nu-nu-nu... nu...! Fif... teen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... 40... 41...! Helios, we can still 
hype this up way more, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... if you taunt me like that...! I 
gotta do it—nope, absolutely impossible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Helios-chan & Palmer-chan... There's only 
one reason why you two lost.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Failing to factor in the power of my and 
Ryan-chan's best-friendship!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Unyaaa~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines, you're always in peak condition! 
Just resting my hands on your shoulders 
tells me everything. Weight, tone... every 
single muscle is beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to training with 
Ryan-chan! Let's keep pushing each other 
to new heights this year too♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A total defeat, seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They really showed us up... Let's hit the 
weights super hard this year!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'll take my leave here~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gimme that laid-back gyaru vibe~. 
Trai-Palmer, get over here too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, this angle is insane. Makes the 
cake look so aesthetic.

Tosen Jordan... She's a friend of Daitaku 
Helios, but unlike her, she tends to keep 
a pretty low-key vibe.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Looking great over here too! Insanely 
photogenic! Man, this app is awesome!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Btw, I took a seriously fire pic recently. 
With a new app~... Look at this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's seriously maxed out?! Who even 
is this?! That's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? My eyes are just slightly bigger, my 
jaw's more defined, I lost weight, and my 
philtrum got shorter, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"That's a pretty wide range! Lol! Anyway, 
in my DMs the other day—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
T-They haven't even touched the cake yet! 
Is this the party people way!?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's got anything to do with 
party people?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I do! Like, shouldn't we cherish going 
with the flow in the moment...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Btw Helios, haven't you not done an Umasta 
live stream lately?

"A live...? Could they mean a livestream 
held on the photo-sharing social media 
platform known as Umastagram?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? Is that so?? Wanna do it right 
now then??

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way in hell am I going out.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Palmer-chin! Get out there!! Take 
a pic of Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-A livestream, huh~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Gotta go with the flow, too! Alright, 
let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy, how's everyone doing!? Feeling 
good-!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait, already 20k concurrent 
viewers!? Insane...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Please spam comments for Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there are so many signs saying 
"Chug!"... But chug what!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "It's allll good! For now, grab a glass!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Btw, wait a sec, my phone is vibrating 
like crazy right now!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The view count is stupid high, it's 
nothing but troll comments, and follow 
requests keep flooding in. Helios's 
streams are just way too exhausting, 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Let's eat cake.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'll take my leave here~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!! An invite from City is super 
rare!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Can't buy a thing, tho☆ Let's all go 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—No, didn't Helios-san message you on 
LANE first?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Teach me about high-end brands next 
time!" she said. My schedule suddenly 
cleared up, so it ended up being today, 
though.

Gold City... A friend of Daitaku Helios 
who also works actively as an Umamusume 
model.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But I'd way rather believe City called me 
out! So that's what we're going with☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever works. Where was it you wanted 
to check out again?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Umm, 'Louie Vuiton' and 'Dior'! And 
'Gucci'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Maybe like a bag or a wallet? I wanna look 
at some accessories!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Though I only really touch on 
that kind of stuff during photoshoots 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I like Yall too. Haute couture is so 
nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I understand. It really is the ultimate 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You've never even worn it for a photoshoot 
before?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, not yet... But I don't plan on 
letting the chance slip away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Once I find a look where I go 'This is 
it!', I definitely plan on ordering it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely~! Haute couture would 
definitely look amazing on you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm gonna wear it, I'll rock it better 
than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whew, as expected♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec! Are you two off in your own 
world!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pien! Looks like you're gonna have to hit 
'em with your model walk, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sparkle, sparkle~☆ Shine, shine~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Walking's super embarrassing, so this 
is it for me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhyaaaa☆ Lookin' so cool!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez. Come on, I'll show you the way, 
let's go.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'll take my leave here~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be you're accepting other 
invitations too?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totes! Palmer, you coming too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Party people are light on their feet! 
We totally gotta go~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nice party vibes! Alright Trainer-P, we're 
headin' out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Way past 'Happy New Year' and 'look 
forward to working with ya,' at this point 
it's more like 'have a good next year' 
vibes, so best wishes!"
